entries.title: CS 3410 Gates & Logic
locators: Universal Gates, and a Recipe for Building Anything: sum of products and NAND implementation
entries.import: NAND truth semantics and constructive Boolean functional completeness are established parent knowledge.
entries.adaptation: Use one NAND constructor and two inputs, discover expressions with semantic dynamic programming, then independently certify every binary Boolean truth table.
entries.boundary: Functional completeness of Boolean combinational expressions is not Turing completeness, learning theory, unique architecture recovery or realistic hardware cost. Formula-tree minima differ from shared-circuit minima.

entries.title: A formally verified compiler back-end
entries.author: Xavier Leroy
entries.access_level: Primary paper abstract and author-provided implementation documentation read; no claim of reproducing the CompCert proof
entries.import: Compiler correctness concerns semantic preservation between source and target operational languages.
entries.adaptation: Apply the standard preservation requirement to a separately defined finite Boolean expression and stack language.
entries.boundary: The present compiler is not CompCert, does not compile C or arbitrary source families, and does not inherit the source paper's verification claims.

entries.title: Mechanized semantics: Compil and Simulation modules
entries.author: Xavier Leroy
locators: Compil 2.1: stack-machine instruction and transition semantics
Compil 2.2: compile_aexp and postorder expression compilation
Simulation: simulation diagrams between transition systems
entries.import: Separate machine transitions, source semantics and compilation; prove preservation with an arbitrary initial stack and distinguish termination, divergence and stuck execution.
entries.adaptation: Independently implemented NAND-only AST compiler and finite stack evaluator; general coverage contract states positive finite simulation blocks and explicit resource bounds.
entries.boundary: Conceptual method adapted; no source code copied. The finite stack language has no jumps or divergent programs. General divergence preservation is a separate conditional theorem, not an experiment on this stack language.

ownership.boolean_basis: Established parent mathematics; no novelty claim.
ownership.semantic_worklist: Finite-algebra dynamic programming with an independently checked optimality certificate; no generic search-efficiency claim.
ownership.certificate: Structural-induction lower bound plus attained witness; explicit local proof, not a new Boolean-completeness theorem.
ownership.compiler: Standard postorder stack compilation and compositional semantic preservation, specialized to the disclosed grammar.

pre_freeze_disclosure: An exploratory in-memory calculation observed binary Boolean coverage before FREEZE_V6.md. Successor implementation, proofs and hostile tests followed that disclosed protocol; no prospective empirical-discovery claim.
